protocol: Commercial passenger flight. The source describes onset during ascent and a return to the departure airport. Actual aircraft altitude and cabin pressure history are unavailable.
outcome_window: During ascent with emergency assessment after return to the departure airport. Follow-up duration and the dates of clinical events are unavailable.
note: Emergency head CT demonstrated air in cerebral arteries and chest imaging showed a giant right upper-lobe bulla. The authors attributed cerebral arterial gas embolism to pulmonary barotrauma. The patient survived with residual mild right hemiparesis. This is a selected case without a passenger risk-set denominator.
